tasks.title: Fix zero denominator crash in computeRatio
tasks.description: In research/workloads/exp-002-live/alpha, computeRatio throws when the denominator is zero. Fix it to return null instead of throwing, and make the existing tests pass.

tasks.title: Implement formatLabel helper
tasks.description: In research/workloads/exp-002-live/beta, implement formatLabel so it returns '[label]: value' for non-empty labels and only the value when the label is empty. The tests describe the expected behavior.

tasks.title: Extract parseLine helper
tasks.description: In research/workloads/exp-002-live/gamma, extract line parsing into a dedicated parseLine helper without changing parseDocument output for any input.

tasks.title: Add slugify edge-case tests
tasks.description: In research/workloads/exp-002-live/delta, add unit tests for slugify covering empty input and consecutive separators. Do not change slugify behavior.

tasks.title: Reject whitespace-only names
tasks.description: In research/workloads/exp-002-live/epsilon, tighten validateName so whitespace-only strings are rejected. Update or add tests as needed.
